factor_name: Upper-Quantile Five-Day US10Y Rate-Shock Residual Reversal

calculation.description: When the five-day US10Y yield-series move is above its trailing 252-observation 75th percentile, rank assets by the negative of their three-day return residual versus the cross-asset median. The signal favors recent relative losers during a lagged rate shock. No signal is emitted outside the active regime. All inputs are lagged through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.03771), 2023-2024 (+0.01851), and 2025-2026 (+0.08870); only 7 qualifying observations occurred from 2026-07 onward (+0.17119), so recent performance is highly uncertain.
